mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong labor market conditions driving robust consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor and consumer spending regime
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and rising RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate over 3 months leads to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 600.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate profits, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and rising GDPC1 fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand contraction regime, negative GDP growth (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters reduces corporate revenue and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is negative for two consecutive quarters.
